mechanism: Prednisolone may increase atomoxetine metabolism via CYP450 induction and increase cardiovascular effects; atomoxetine's sympathomimetic activity combined with corticosteroid effects on fluid/electrolyte balance poses moderate risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and mood/behavior; ensure adequate potassium supplementation if needed; consider dose adjustment of atomoxetine if prednisolone is high-dose or prolonged.
